faq.q: What is Feria San Bernabé in Marbella?
faq.a: Feria San Bernabé is Marbella’s annual summer fair, honouring the city’s patron saint. It runs for a week in June (9–15 June 2039) with live music, fairground rides, food stalls, and a festive atmosphere across the town centre and Puerto Banús.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book a boat party for Feria San Bernabé 2039?
faq.a: We recommend booking at least 4–6 weeks ahead for Feria week. Many groups secure Tier A yachts (€749/2h) or Tier B (€4,719/4h) by early May. Last-minute availability is slim, especially for 12-pax boats like the Mangusta 80.

faq.q: Which yacht is best for a Feria boat party with 12 people?
faq.a: The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) or Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) are ideal. Both depart from Puerto Banús, include a skipper, drinks, snacks, and the Mangusta 80 also includes a jet ski. Minimum charter is 4 hours at €4,719 for the Mangusta.

faq.a: Yes, you can bring your own food and decorations. The charter includes light snacks, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava. If you want a catered menu or themed setup, let us know via WhatsApp and we can arrange it at an extra cost.

faq.q: What is the cancellation policy for boat rentals during Feria?
faq.a: Cancellations made 14+ days before departure receive a full refund. Between 7–13 days, a 50% refund applies. Less than 7 days, no refund. We recommend travel insurance for peace of mind. Contact us via WhatsApp for any changes.

faq.a: No, every yacht has a built-in sound system (Bluetooth or AUX). You can connect your phone and play your own playlist. Some larger yachts like the Ferretti 94 have premium speakers. Just bring your phone and a charging cable.

data.body_html:
Feria San Bernabé 2039 in Marbella is the summer highlight: a week of music, dancing, and celebration from 9 to 15 June. But the real magic happens on the water. A boat party from Puerto Banús lets you enjoy the Feria buzz with your own private crew, unlimited drinks, and a stunning Costa del Sol backdrop. Whether you’re a group of 9 or 12, our yachts offer a floating VIP experience just minutes from the fairgrounds.

Why a boat party for Feria San Bernabé?

Marbella’s Feria is packed with events, but it can get crowded. A boat party gives you space, privacy, and a unique perspective. You’ll cruise along the Golden Mile, past La Concha mountain, and anchor at coves like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. Plus, with a dedicated skipper, you can focus on celebrating – not navigating. Our Tier A yachts, like the Azimut 39, start at €749 for two hours, including drinks and snacks. That’s a competitive price for a premium group experience.

Our Feria fleet: boats for every group

We operate from Puerto Banús, a 5-minute drive from Marbella Marina. Here are the top picks for your Feria boat party:

  • Tier A: Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – €749/2h, €2,299/8h. Perfect for smaller groups wanting a budget-friendly party.
  • Tier B: Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – €4,719 minimum 4h. Includes a jet ski. Ideal for a luxury celebration.
  • Other favourites: Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax), Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax), Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax). Pricing on request via WhatsApp.

All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and IVA. No hidden costs.

Suggested Feria boat party itinerary

Most Feria boat parties last 2–4 hours. A typical route: depart Puerto Banús, head east towards Cabopino or west towards Estepona. Anchor at a calm cove for swimming, music, and photos. Return to port in time for the evening Feria events. For longer charters (8 hours), you can reach Sotogrande or even Gibraltar on the horizon. The average sea temperature in June is 22–24°C – perfect for a dip.

What’s included in your Feria boat party

Every booking includes:

  • Licensed skipper (English & Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the entire charter
  • Unlimited water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (crisps, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

You’re welcome to bring your own food, decorations, or a cake. Just let us know in advance via WhatsApp so we can accommodate.

How to book your Feria San Bernabé boat party

Booking is simple. Contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and budget. We’ll confirm availability and send a payment link (50% deposit to secure, balance due 7 days before). For Feria week, we recommend booking by mid-April 2039. Our Tier A yachts often sell out first. Need help choosing? Browse our full fleet or message us directly.
